extensionDescription.message: Tree-style tab management for the native vertical tab strip: collapsible subtrees, close-with-children, and drag-to-nest.

commandToggleCollapsed.message: Collapse or expand the current tab's subtree

commandCloseTree.message: Close the current tab and its whole subtree

commandOutdent.message: Promote the current tab one level

commandIndent.message: Nest the current tab under the previous sibling

indentHint.message: How far each child level is pushed in

indentGuidesHint.message: Faint lines that connect children to their parent

hiddenTabCountHint.message: Badge after the title of a collapsed parent showing the number of tabs inside

animationsHint.message: Glide on collapse, expand and re-parent (also off when Windows animations are off)

dropHighlightHint.message: Ring and line that show where a dragged tab will land

plusOpensChild.message: The plus button opens a child tab

plusOpensChildHint.message: Off: new tabs always start a new tree

askClosingTreeHint.message: When closing a tab would close at least this many descendants (0 = never ask)

nativeConnectedDetail.message: The native module is loaded and has compatibility data for this Chrome build.

nativeUnavailableDetail.message: The native module is not installed, or Chrome has not been restarted since it was installed. Tabs stay unchanged.

nativeSetupIntro.message: Press Win+R (or open a terminal), paste this command and press Enter. Quit Chrome when the installer asks, then start it again.

nativeSecurityNote.message: Chrome normally lets only Microsoft-signed DLLs load into the processes it starts, such as renderers and the GPU process. To work, the native module turns that one protection off for them, which lowers their code-integrity protection. The command downloads the installer from ArborTab's GitHub releases; it only installs the native module next to chrome.exe, and the same page offers uninstall.ps1 to remove it.

nativeManualDownload.message: Prefer to inspect the files first? Download the package manually

safeModeDetail.message: Chrome exited abnormally $1 times in a row while the native features were on, so they were turned off. The compatibility data for this Chrome version may be wrong.

offsetsResolvingDetail.message: Loading the compatibility data for Chrome $1…

offsetsWaitingDetail.message: Compatibility data for Chrome $1 is not published yet. They usually appear within a day or two of a Chrome release; ArborTab checks again every 30 minutes.

offsetsDisabledDetail.message: Compatibility-data downloads are disabled in config.ini and no data is cached for Chrome $1.

offsetsErrorDetail.message: The compatibility data for Chrome $1 failed validation, so tabs stay unchanged. See native.log for details.

updateNativeDetail.message: This extension needs a newer native module. Download the latest package and install it again.

updateExtensionDetail.message: The native module needs a newer extension. Update ArborTab on chrome://extensions.

backgroundNoAnswer.message: The background worker did not answer.

closeGenericQuestion.message: Close this tab and its descendants?

closeOneQuestion.message: Close this tab and its 1 descendant?

closeManyQuestion.message: Close this tab and its $1 descendants?

debugInfoHint.message: Versions, connection state, settings and recent events (no URLs or titles). Attach it to a bug report, along with $1 if the native module is installed.
